paite: Huan Joseph in apa mai asi a, akah a, atawp hi.
english: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

paite: Joseph in asikha damdawi siamte apa luang muat thei lou a bawl ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in damdawisiamte'n Israel luang muat thei lou in abawl uhi.
english: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

paite: Aluang bawlna in ni sawmli azang ua; muat thei lou a bawlna ding a ni hiai zah lut zel mah ahi. Ni sawmsagih sung teng Aiguptate'n amah asuun uhi.
english: Forty days were fulfilled for him, for that is how many the days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for him for seventy days.

paite: Amah asuun nite uh abei nung in, Joseph in Pharaoh inkuante ahoupih a, "Na mitmuh ua deihsakna ka tanleh hehpih in Pharaoh bil a zak ding in, 'Ka pa'n, ngai in, si ding ka hita.
english: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

paite: Kanaan gam a ka han ding a ka tohsa ngei ah na hon vui ding ahi,' chi in ahon kichiamsak hi. Huaiziak in tu in hehpih in ka pa hon potousak inla, hon va vuisak in. Huchi in ka hong pai nawn ding, achi, chi in hon gensak un," achi hi.
english: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”

paite: Pharaoh in, "Ahon kichiamsak bang in na pa va potou ve," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”

paite: Joseph, apa vui ding in ava hohtou hi. Pharaoh sikha teng, a-inkuan lak a upate leh Aigupta gam upate tengteng leh,
english: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

paite: Joseph inkuanpih tengteng leh asanggamte leh apa inkuanpihte, akiang ah ava hohtou uhi. Ataneu chikchikte uleh abelamhonte uleh abawnghonte kia uh Goshen gam ah anusia uhi.
english: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

paite: Akiang uah kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite leng ahohtou ua, pawlching petmah ahi uh.
english: There went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.

paite: Jordan lui gal a Atad phual atung ua, huai ah nakpitak in akah ua, ni sagih sung apa suunna anei uhi.
english: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

paite: Hiai gammi Kanaante'n, Atad phual a ami suun uh amuh un, “Hiai Aiguptate misi suunna thupitak ahi," achi uhi. Huaiziak in huai mun Abel- mizraim asa ua, huai Jordan lui gal a om ahi.
english: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

paite: Atapate'n athupiak bang in ahihsak uhi.
english: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,

paite: Atapate'n Kanaan gam ah azawnglut ua, Abraham in kivuina mun ding a, Hit mi Ephron a kipan alou toh aleikhawm Mamre ma a Makpelah lou a kokhuk ah avuita uhi.
english: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

paite: Apa avui khit in Joseph leh asanggamte leh apa vui ding a amah toh hohtou tengteng Aigupta gam ah akik nawnta uhi.
english: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

paite: Joseph sanggamte'n apa uh sita ahi chih amuh un, "Joseph in ahon mudah ding a, atung a i thilhihkhelh tengteng phu i tung uah akim in ahon la kha ding e,” achi uhi.
heading: Joseph In Asanggamte Atheisak Thak
english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all of the evil which we did to him.”

paite: Joseph kiang a hilh ding in mi asawl ua, "Na pa'n asih ma in hichi in thu apia hi.
english: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

paite: Joseph kiang ah, 'Hehpih in na sanggamte tatlekna leh agitlouhna uh ngaidam in. Na tung ah thil hoih lou ahihta ngal ua. Tu in hehpih in na pa Pathian sikhate tatlekna ngaidam in,' achi, chi in va gen un," achi hi. Akiang a agentak un Joseph akap hi.
english: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

paite: Asanggamte leng ava hoh ua, ama ah abokkhup chiat ua, "Ngai in, na sikhate ka hi uh," achi uhi.
english: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

paite: Joseph in akiang uah, "Lau kei un. Pathian sik a om ka hi a hia?
english: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

paite: 20 Nou zaw ka tung ah thil gilou hih lungsim na pu ua; himahleh tuni in mi tampi hing leh dam a humbitna ding a thil hoih suahsak Pathian lungsim ahi zaw hi.
english: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save many people alive.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in lau kei un. Nou leh na taneu chikchikte uh ka hon vak ding," achi hi. Huchi in amau alungmuan a, kamsiamtak in ahoupih hi.
english: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will nourish you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

paite: Joseph, amah leh apa inkuanpihte toh Aigupta gam ah ateng ua, Joseph kum za-le-sawmkhat adam hi.
heading: Joseph Sihna
english: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

paite: Joseph in Ephraim ta, tusawn thum chiang amu hi. Manasseh tapa Makir tate leng Joseph phei tung a khanglian ngen ahi uh.
english: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

paite: Joseph in asanggamte kiang ah, "Si ding ka hita hi. Himahleh Pathian in ahong veh ngeingei ding a, hiai gam a kipan hon pikhia in, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a, piak ding achiamsa gam ah ahon pitou ding," achi hi.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

paite: Joseph in Israel suante akichiamsak a, "Pathian in ahong veh ngeingei ding a, hiai a kipan ka guhte na potou ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”

paite: Huchi in Joseph kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi. Aluang muat thei lou ding in abawl ua, Aigupta gam ah hankuang sung ah akoih uhi.
english: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
